title: Calligram outline sheet (clean copy) and coloured pens
subject: English
source: Written for english/y4 lesson 42 (Calligram outline sheet (clean copy) and coloured pens)
intro: Lesson 42: Publishing and performing our calligrams. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Edit before publishing
points: Is every word the strongest choice?

parts.text: Read once too fast: pupils notice the problem
Read again slowly, pausing at each line end
Stress the verbs: piercing, shrugging, standing guard
Quieter on the last line, like the sleeping valley

keywords.def: make a final copy to share
the rise and fall of your voice

questions.q: Edit: The mountin is big and it has snow on it.
questions.a: For example: The towering mountain wears a cap of snow.

questions.q: Which word in your poem will you stress?

questions.a: At the end of each line

questions.q: Core: write your final calligram neatly on a clean outline, then perform it to the class on Teams
questions.a: A published calligram and a performance

questions.q: Extend: give a classmate a WWW about their performance
questions.a: For example: WWW your pause before the last line

questions.q: Stretch: write two sentences explaining how your shape adds to the meaning
questions.a: For example: My lines widen like the mountain, so the reader travels from the summit to the valley.

questions.q: What helps listeners most when you perform a poem?
options: pausing at the end of lines
questions.a: B) pausing at the end of lines. Pausing lets each image land. Rushing and never looking up make it hard to follow.
A) make a final copy to share
options: make a final copy to share

questions.q: What did you enjoy about performing?
